$comment: Single source of truth for image and video assets. Consumed by scripts/build-*.mjs and src/data/assets.ts. Source files in ./image carry timestamp suffixes and literal U+2026 characters (unsafe in URLs), so this manifest defines the canonical public names. Each source must appear exactly once — the build script enforces uniqueness.
